title: Personal Loans Refinance Pricing Memo: Credit for a FlexLine in Good Standing
content:
## Rule

A FlexLine credit comes off the refinance fee percent of a Personal Loans refinance application (a borrower holds at most one open FlexLine): a FlexLine of the borrower in active status opened 12 or more whole months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the application date, with no FlexLine late fee charged fewer than 12 whole months before it, earns 0.5 point; a FlexLine in active status opened fewer than 12 whole months before, with no such late fee, earns 0.25 point; a borrower with neither earns no FlexLine credit.

The FlexLine is the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit account; its status, its open date and its late fees are read from the borrower's FlexLine records. The refinance fee percent, with this credit taken off, never goes below zero.

| Borrower's FlexLine | FlexLine late fee fewer than 12 whole months before the application date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| active, opened 12 or more whole months before | none | 0.50 point |
| active, opened fewer than 12 whole months before | none | 0.25 point |
| active, any open date | one or more | none |
| frozen, in repayment, closed, or no FlexLine | any | none |

## Cases (hypothetical, application on 5 June)

- Active FlexLine opened 5 June of the year before, no FlexLine late fee in the window: 12 whole months: 0.50 point.
- Active FlexLine opened 6 June of the year before: 11 whole months: 0.25 point.
- Active FlexLine opened three years before with a FlexLine late fee charged on 6 June of the year before: that fee is 11 whole months back: none.
